purpose: Initialize the factory third-party JPEG_R enable value before the first camera configuration for a fresh persistent-property store, removing the measured ordinary-JPEG-first dependency.

factory_provenance.integration_decision: Seed the measured factory rule output as a system build-property default; not a copied factory init or build.prop assignment.

verification.native_compilation: not required for the property fragment; successor build unverified
verification.separate_v8_runtime_result: Rear and front Aperture JPEG_R saved and decoded with libultrahdr after the existing factory Eco rule initialized the property; this does not verify the new default.
